orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Orders placed through chat or entered by your team. Confirm them, move them along and verify payments.
orders.moduleOff: The orders module is off for this business. Turn it on in Business setup → Industry.
orders.truncated: Showing the {limit} most recent orders. Use the filters to see others.

sound.hint: Play a sound when a new order arrives

filters.search: Search by number, customer or phone

empty.title: No orders yet
empty.description: When a customer orders through chat it shows up here instantly.

detail.title: Order details
detail.heading: Order #{number}
detail.proofUnavailable: The payment proof could not be loaded.
detail.noConversation: This order has no conversation, so the customer can't be notified.
detail.cancelReasonPlaceholder: E.g. we ran out of stock
detail.shippingOnDelivery: Shipping: paid by the customer on delivery
detail.checkoutPending: Sent from the WhatsApp cart: the customer got the link to pick shipping and payment and hasn't completed it yet. The total doesn't include shipping yet.

timeline.checkout: The customer completed shipping and payment in the store

errors.generic: The order could not be updated. Please try again.
errors.outOfStock: Not enough stock of "{name}". Adjust inventory or cancel the order.
errors.not_found: The order doesn't exist or was deleted.
errors.closed: This order is already closed (delivered or cancelled).
errors.not_pending: The order is no longer pending.
errors.not_cancellable: This order can no longer be cancelled.
errors.Forbidden: You don't have permission for this action.
errors.Unauthorized: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

new.title: New order
new.description: Enter an order taken by phone or in person. Prices come from the catalog.
new.searchCustomer: Search contacts by name or phone

errors.generic: The order could not be created.
errors.unavailable: An item is no longer available{name}
errors.price_on_request: "{name}" has no price, so it can't be ordered this way.
errors.foreign_currency: "{name}" is priced in another currency; orders only take the business currency.
errors.Forbidden: You don't have permission to create orders.

settings.title: Orders
settings.description: How customers receive the orders they place through chat.
settings.fulfillmentRequired: Enable at least one fulfillment option.
settings.notify: Message the customer when the status changes
settings.notifyHint: A message is sent in the conversation when the order is confirmed, prepared, dispatched or delivered. You can turn it off per order.

methods.title: Payment methods
methods.description: Shown to the customer after they place an order. Payments are verified by hand.
methods.empty: No payment methods yet. Add a wallet QR, a bank account or cash.
methods.editorHint: Customers will see everything you write here.
methods.name: Name
methods.badImage: Use a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.
methods.imageTooBig: The image is larger than 8 MB.
methods.uploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded: {reason}
methods.requiresProofHint: The customer is asked for a screenshot of the payment so you can verify it.
methods.deleteDescription: "{name}" will no longer be shown to customers. Past orders keep its name.

store.title: Online store
store.description: Your catalog as a web store: customers fill their cart, enter their details and the order lands in Orders.
store.readOnly: Only admins can change the store.

publish.title: Publish store
publish.hint: Until you publish it, only your team can see it (preview).

ready.title: To publish your store you still need:
ready.ordersModule: Turn on orders (Business setup → Orders & payments).
ready.shipping: An active shipping profile or store pickup.
ready.payment: An active payment method (Business setup → Orders & payments).
ready.products: At least one active product with a price or a service shown in the store.

look.title: Look
look.whatsappHint: With country code, e.g. 51987654321. Empty = the business phone.

pickup.title: Store pickup
pickup.enable: Let customers pick up their order

store.checkoutNotePlaceholder: E.g. We ship Monday to Friday.

shipping.title: Shipping profiles
shipping.description: Set what shipping costs. Customers pick one at checkout.
shipping.empty: No shipping profiles yet. Create at least one (or turn on store pickup) to publish your store.

typeHint.flat: One price per order, no matter how many products.
typeHint.weight: The price depends on the order’s total weight (the products’ weights added up).
typeHint.on_delivery: The store doesn’t charge for shipping: the customer pays the courier when the order arrives.

shipping.name: Name
shipping.freeOverHint: When the subtotal reaches this amount, shipping is free.
shipping.ratesHint: Leave the last range’s “up to” empty to cover any heavier weight. Otherwise heavier orders can’t use this option.
shipping.missingWeight: {n} active products have no weight: they count as 0 kg for weight-based shipping.

errors.name: Enter a name.
errors.rates: Check the ranges: each needs a price and a weight above 0.
errors.rate_order: Ranges must go from low to high, and only the last one may be open.
errors.free_over: The free-shipping amount is not valid.
errors.last_profile: Your store is published and this is its only shipping option. Create another or turn on pickup first.
errors.too_many: You reached the maximum number of profiles.

fees.title: Extra charges
fees.description: Fixed amounts added to shipped orders, such as packaging. Not charged when the customer picks up in store. If optional, the customer ticks it at checkout.
fees.name: Concept
fees.max: You can have up to {n} charges.

address.title: Your store address
address.hint: Only letters, numbers and dashes. For example, your business name.
address.oldLinks: Your previous links keep working: they lead to the new address.

errors.reserved: That address is reserved. Pick another.
errors.taken: Another business already uses that address.

stock.title: Stock and waitlist
stock.description: How customers see the stock of products that track it. Each product can have its own rule.
stock.hidden: Hide (only “Sold out” when nothing is left)
stock.low: Only “Almost gone!” when few units are left
stock.waitlist: “Notify me when available” button on sold-out products
stock.waitlistHint: The customer leaves their WhatsApp, joins the Waitlist and their WhatsApp opens with a message for you.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp catalog
whatsapp.description: Your products show in your WhatsApp: the shop icon in the chat, the cart and product cards. Every price, photo or stock change in Whasalia goes to WhatsApp right away.
whatsapp.sourceOfTruth: Whasalia is the source of truth: whatever you edit directly in Meta Commerce Manager is replaced on the next sync.
whatsapp.noWhatsApp: Connect your WhatsApp number in Channels first.
whatsapp.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect the catalog? The shop and cart are hidden in your WhatsApp and changes stop being sent. The catalog stays in your Meta account.
whatsapp.orders: When a customer sends their cart on WhatsApp, the order shows in Orders and the customer gets a link to pick shipping and payment.

error.permission: Your WhatsApp connection can't manage catalogs. Reconnect the number in Channels and accept the catalog permission (catalog_management).
error.already_linked: This number already has another catalog connected in Meta. Choose that catalog or disconnect it in WhatsApp Manager.
error.whatsapp_not_connected: The WhatsApp number isn't connected properly.
error.business_missing: We couldn't find this number's Meta business account.

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.description: Customers who asked to be told when a product is back in stock. When you restock it, tap “Notify” and they get a WhatsApp message.
waitlist.empty: Nobody is waiting for a product right now. When a customer taps “Notify me when available” on a sold-out product, they show up here.

template.title: “Notify stock arrival” template
template.why: WhatsApp only lets you write freely up to 24 h after the customer's last message. After that, the notice goes out with this Meta-approved template.
template.draft: It's ready: it only needs to be sent to Meta for approval.
template.pending: Sent to Meta, under review. Meanwhile you can only notify people who wrote to you in the last 24 h.
template.submitted: Template sent to Meta for approval.
template.noWhatsApp: Connect a WhatsApp number in Channels to send it to Meta.
template.needed: You turned on “Notify me when available”, but the “Notify stock arrival” template isn't approved yet. Send it to Meta so you can notify customers after 24 h.

reason.no_stock: the product has no stock yet
reason.window_closed: more than 24 h since their last message
reason.template_missing: the “Notify stock arrival” template is missing
reason.template_pending: the template isn't approved by Meta yet
